notes: Both multi-morpheme units are genuinely indivisible: מֵאֵת → *of* is rule 23's compound preposition headed on the governing opening morpheme, and בְּטֶרֶם → *before* meets rule 30's one-English-word condition, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme.

The italic *them* is added rather than folded into תִּמְנַע, since no object morpheme stands in the clause for rule 44 to reach; the מִן of מִמֶּנִּי is unrepresented under rule 40 beside the bare indirect object *me*.
